mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the pineal gland was most worthwhile: the planned day-and-night comparison connects the pathway to melatonin release and shows how light at night can suppress it.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the outgoing nerve route was less satisfying: its course through the spinal cord and neck is shown, but why it takes that route is not explained.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the nerve route to the pineal gland passes through the spinal cord and a nerve cluster in the neck.

arbitrary.text: No action seemed purposeless: each connected part of the stated pathway. The indirect route itself remained unexplained, though.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the body's daily rhythms connect to other functions, though this chapter's choices mostly followed a straightforward assembly.
